summary: Current window/repository must be AlembicCore. Read parent AGENTS.md, this state root, accepted CO-5A controller decision evt-20260620201747-0033 and evidence-repaired CO-5A result, then AlembicCore AGENTS/CLAUDE and current Core source. Work only in AlembicCore. CO-5B is a producer-first replacement-support package, not a deletion/internalization task and not a sibling migration task. Starting from CO-5A facts, add or extend real supported AlembicCore replacement/test-fixture surfaces needed to let downstream AlembicPlugin/Alembic tests and configs migrate away from residual transitional imports such as @alembic/core/core/ast/*, @alembic/core/core/analysis, @alembic/core/core/discovery, and retired project-intelligence test imports. The replacement surface must be backed by existing Core implementation call chains or stable fixture helpers; avoid empty barrels, type-only placeholders, mock-only adapters, or compatibility aliases with no consumer path. Keep all old transitional exports/routes available for later CO-5C/consumer migration until scans and consumer changes prove they are removable. Do not delete or internalize @alembic/core/core/ast/*, @alembic/core/core/analysis, @alembic/core/core/discovery, @alembic/core/project-intelligence residual routes, KnowledgeService compatibility aliases, service/quality, service/bootstrap, or any RecipeContext unused-kind behavior in CO-5B. Do not edit sibling repositories, vendor snapshots, release pointers, plugin marketplace assets, runtime delivery files, or product behavior outside Core. Required work: 1) inspect residual sibling test/config imports from CO-5A and current scans; 2) decide the smallest stable Core-owned fixture/public support path, preferably @alembic/core/test-fixtures or another already-supported Core replacement export, for parser/discovery/analysis/project-intelligence test needs; 3) implement the support with focused unit/smoke coverage and public-api-boundary/package-export updates only if needed; 4) document exact downstream migration guidance in the TargetResultEnvelope, including which old imports can now move and which still require a controller/user decision. Verification expected before TargetResultEnvelope: pre/post git status; focused rg scans for residual relevant exports/imports; focused tests for new fixture/support helpers; npm run build:check; npm run build; npm run smoke:public-api; npm run lint:public-api-boundary; npm run lint:consumer-core-imports; npm run lint; git diff --check and git diff --cached --check. Return commit hash or explicit no-code-change reason, changed files, raw command outputs, export/boundary changes, downstream migration map, residual blockers, risks, and next-step recommendation. If implementation would require changing sibling consumers, deleting legacy routes, reclassifying RecipeContext kinds, or changing production behavior, stop and return blocked/needs-controller with evidence instead of expanding scope.
